prompt.project_info: Create a stylized editorial portrait with a giant sculptural mouth backdrop and colorful streetwear styling.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional person in a black sweatshirt, tan cargo pants, white-and-blue generic sneakers, long colorful braids, rings, bracelets, and manicured nails, seated comfortably with legs naturally angled and hands resting on the lap.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up to medium low-angle framing, subject centered inside a giant open-mouth sculpture with glossy magenta lips, white teeth, decorative jeweled braces, and braided hair ropes framing the sides; replace any brand logo with a blank graphic area.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool frontal studio light with warm accents, hard specular highlights, high contrast, deep magenta, navy, silver, and soft blue palette.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic stylized editorial, realistic clothing, hair, teeth sculpture, jewelry, and hands, no text or real branding.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Stylized photorealistic editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional streetwear model seated comfortably inside a giant open-mouth sculpture, glossy magenta lips, white teeth with decorative jeweled braces, colorful long braids framing the sides, black sweatshirt, tan cargo pants, generic white-and-blue sneakers, hands resting on lap, cool studio light with warm accents, low-angle centered composition, no logos or text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, legs spread suggestively, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, real brand logo, watermark, text, distorted anatomy, gore, uncanny teeth
